newsitem.title: USA: Karts Int'l in reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: Karts Int'l in reverse stock split.

text.p: Karts International Inc said Tuesday that it declared a two-for-three reverse stock split of its common shares effective March 24.
The company said stockholders due fractional shares as a result of the reverse stock split were issued one full share of common stock instead.
As a result of the reverse stock split, the company's trading symbol has been changed from KIII.OB to.
Karts International is a manufacturer of recreational go-karts.
